# Fallout 76: Patch notes – March 1, 2022 / Patch 33/34

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_110_nukaknights-post-patchnotes33-34.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Our latest update for Fallout 76 arrives today, bringing a new seasonal event, Season 8, Fallout Worlds improvements, and more to the game. Here you can find out all the details.
### UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS

**The Aliens Have Landed:** Aliens have appeared on Earth and are targeting our brainwaves! Join others in tackling a new extraterrestrial seasonal event every hour until March 15th.
**Season 8 Begins:** Enjoy life in the cozy Vault once again as you level up and earn new weapon and armor skins, C.A.M.P. items, a new ally, and many more board rewards in Season 8.
**S.C.O.R.E. Earn in Fallout Worlds:** Continue your journey through public and custom worlds to complete S.C.O.R.E. to earn, level up and receive board rewards.
**New Custom World Settings:** Experiment in your custom worlds with even more freedom when placing C.A.M.P. objects, the ability to toggle V.A.T.S. and skill card effects, and more!

### UPDATE VERSION 1.6.4.13

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Bethesda.net):** 10.0 GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 17.9GB
**PC (Steam):** 11.6GB
**PlayStation:** 18.1GB
**Xbox:** 17.2GB

### NEW SEASONAL EVENT

Mysterious beings from beyond the stars have appeared in the sky and want to drain the brainwaves of resident life forms across Appalachia! Take on the aliens together with others and send them back to their ships with their tails between their legs before they can finish their “research”.

**Every hour until March 15**, an alien mothership will materialize over one of six landmarks in Appalachia to activate three brainwave suckers.

- Go to the mothership location and examine Sucker Kappa to start the event.
- When the event begins, you must destroy the three brainwave suckers one by one before the aliens can complete their brainwave extraction.

- There's just one problem: each sucker is protected by a force field, each controlled by an alien commander.
- Defeat alien forces to lure out the commander in charge of each sucker. If you turn it off, the force field collapses and you can destroy the vacuum cleaner with your fellow event participants.
- If you can destroy all three brainwave suckers in time, you'll receive loot, XP, and a chance to get blueprints to craft new alien weapons - such as the Alien Disintegrator and Electro Enforcer - as well as new high-tech C.A.M.P. items.
- Stay alert! While the seasonal event is active, you can encounter aliens at certain public events, including Campfire Stories, Free Range, and Against the Sound Barrier. The curious visitors can also be discovered in new random encounters that we are adding with this update.

### SEASON 8: NEW BOARD, NEW REWARDS AND MUCH MORE!

Here's what you can expect in Fallout 76 Season 8, which begins today:

**New Board:** Enjoy the benefits of a Cozy Vault once again on a brand new board in Season 8. Reach Rank 100 (or higher!) this season to earn a range of new rewards that even a Warden would be jealous of.

- As you progress through the season, you'll unlock new paint jobs for your weapons, armor and power armor, stylish gear for your C.A.M.P., a new ally, outfits, cosmetics, consumables, and more
